method: Static code review plus CPU admission tests; no GPU probing or inference
review: Independent read-only guard review accepted the path/option fixes; GPU launch safeguards remain blockers.

checks.check: placement and one 48 GB card off trinity-0-13
checks.evidence: No GPU launcher exists. require_go checks only PART2_GO=1; neither placement nor card/node is verified.

checks.check: two empty nvidia-smi readings 300 seconds apart
checks.evidence: No nvidia-smi or 300-second wait in the launcher or GPU script; no readings taken in this CPU task.
Shown in the GPU script docstring only; the CPU launcher uses run.sh and nice, not vnice.
No timeout in the launcher or GPU script. The pass timer starts after tower load and plan creation and excludes STEP5.
HARD_GPU_H=1.2 drives the ten-capture projection and a post-capture elapsed check; there is no interrupt for a stalled capture. New phrases drop first if projection is too large.
The new gate refuses existing STOP.json/KILLED/KILLED.json. No external launcher records abrupt kills, so an unmarked partial pass can still resume by skipping existing receipts.

checks.check: writes only under GPU output directory
checks.evidence: OUT is out/pool_part2, but TIMING_RECEIPT.json is written under out/. No GPU launcher confines runtime caches.
gate.py runs before imports/writes in the direct GPU/scoring entry points, and before mkdir in the CPU launchers; tested on planted files and missing/altered bars.
